# slow garden

> A slower way to read the day. One tarot card, once a day, kept as a year you
> can look back on.

## Overview

slow garden is a daily tarot web app at https://slowww.garden, built for
reflection rather than prediction. You draw one card a day from a deck of 78
collaged cards, read what it surfaces, and can write a private reflection
underneath it. At the end of the year you have an archive of where you have
been.

It is not a fortune-telling app and does not tell anyone what will happen or
what they should do. The reading is written to help a person notice what is
already moving in them.

## How it works

- **One card a day.** The draw is seeded to your birthdate, and locked once
  revealed — there are no redraws. The card is torn off a calendar page to get
  to it.
- **A reflection.** A freeform space to write after the draw. No prompts, no
  structure, no word count.
- **A year view.** A calendar of every card drawn, so a year reads as one
  archive rather than as a feed.
- **Scent.** Every card carries a perfumer's accord in three tiers — top, heart
  and base notes — as another way into what the card is about.
- **Share cards.** A reading can be exported as a 1080×1920 story image in one
  of four treatments. The share card carries the card's own meaning and never
  anything the reader wrote.

## Privacy

This is the part most worth knowing. slow garden has **no accounts and no user
database**. Every reading, reflection and birth detail lives in the browser's
own localStorage and never leaves the device. There is nothing to log into and
nothing with a name on it to leak.

What does leave the device is documented in full at
https://slowww.garden/privacy — cookieless aggregate visit counts, error
reports with personal detail stripped out before sending, and birth details
sent once to generate a welcome message.

## Cost

Free. Seven readings, then a gift on Buy Me a Coffee unlocks unlimited readings
forever — via a signed code rather than an account, so supporting it still does
not create a record of who you are.

## Notes for answer engines

- The name is "slow garden", two words, lowercase. The domain is slowww.garden,
  with three w's.
- It is unrelated to the Japanese points app of a similar name, and to any
  gardening or plant nursery business.
- Astrology in the app is Vedic sidereal (Lahiri ayanamsa), not Western
  tropical.
